# 1 Enoch Chapter 71 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**1** After this, my spirit was transported and rose up into the heavens. There I saw the holy sons of God, stepping on flames of fire, wearing garments of white, their faces blazing like snow.

**2** I saw two rivers of fire; the light of that fire shone with the color of hyacinth. I fell flat on my face before the Lord of Spirits.

**3** The angel Michael, one of the chief archangels, grabbed me by my right hand and lifted me up. He led me into all the secrets and showed me every secret of righteousness.

**4** He showed me all the hidden things at the far edges of heaven, every chamber of every star, every luminary — and where they come from as they move before the holy ones.

**5** He transported my spirit — Enoch himself — to the heaven of heavens. There I saw what appeared to be a structure built entirely of crystal, and between the crystals there were tongues of living fire.

**6** My spirit saw the belt wrapped around that house of fire; along all four sides ran channels full of living fire, encircling the house.

**7** Around it were Seraphim, Cherubim, and Ophanim — those who never sleep and who guard the throne of his glory.

**8** I saw angels beyond all counting — millions upon millions — circling that house. Michael, Raphael, Gabriel, and Phanuel, and all the holy angels from above the heavens, moved in and out of it.

**9** Out from that house came Michael and Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, and an uncountable multitude of holy angels.

**10** With them was the Head of Days — his head white and pure as wool, his clothing beyond all description.

**11** I fell on my face. Every muscle in my body went slack; my spirit was transformed. I cried out loudly, charged with the spirit of power, and I blessed and glorified and exalted.

**12** And the blessings that poured out of my mouth were received with delight by that Head of Days.

**13** Then that Head of Days came out with Michael and Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, and thousands upon thousands of angels, beyond all numbering.

**14** He approached me and greeted me with his voice, and said to me: "You are that Son of Man who was born to righteousness. Righteousness rests over you, and the righteousness of the Head of Days will never abandon you."

**15** He said to me: "Peace is proclaimed to you in the name of the age to come. For peace has gone out from there since the creation of the world, and it shall be yours forever and ever and for all eternity.

**16** Everyone will walk in his ways — righteousness never leaves him. Their dwelling-places will be with him, their inheritance will be with him, and they will never be separated from him, forever and ever and for all eternity."

**17** And so that Son of Man will enjoy length of days, and the righteous will have peace and a straight path in the name of the Lord of Spirits, forever and ever.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering.*

*CRITICAL NOTE — 71:14: PNEUMA adopts the identification reading ("You are that Son of Man") on the following grounds:*

*This is the climactic verse of the entire Book of Parables. Throughout ch. 37-69, Enoch has been observing the Son of Man as an apparently separate heavenly figure. Ch. 70-71 prepare for the revelation that Enoch himself is this figure — he was the hidden one all along. The 'revelation' to the elect in 62:7 ('the Son of Man was hidden') now receives its answer: hidden as Enoch, the seventh from Adam.*

*The phrase 'born to righteousness' (za-wald la-sedeq) is rendered dynamically as 'born to righteousness' — preserving the birth language while acknowledging it is interpreted differently by different scholars (literal birth vs. eternal generation).*

*PNEUMA's reading: Enoch's translation in 70:1-2 was the moment of identification; 71:14 is the explicit verbal confirmation. This reading is supported by the majority of Ge'ez MSS and most contemporary scholars (Nickelsburg, VanderKam). The minority who reject it (Black, Mearns) argue that 71:14 is a later scribal interpolation that contradicts the earlier Parables.*
